senses.gloss: (b. h.) to tremble, fear; to revere; to shun.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 88a:6">Sabb. 88ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 76:9">Ps. LXXVI, 9</cite>) <he>אם יָרְאָה וכ׳</he> if she (the earth) trembled, how could she be at rest, &c.?—
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:18">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ליִרְאָה את שמך</he> so as to fear thy name.—(Usu. as participle or adjective) <cite ref="J00591"><he>יָרֵא</he></cite> m.
Ned. 8ᵇ (ref. to Mal. III, 20) אלו … שהן יְרֵאִין להוציא וכ׳ who are afraid to utter the name of the Lord in vain.—יְרֵא חֵטא shunning sin, of careful conduct, conscientious.
Ib. 8; a. fr.—יְרֵא שָׁמַיִם God-fearing, pious.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:21">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>גדול … יותר מי׳ ש׳</he> he who lives on the (honest) labor of his hand, stands higher than the pious man.
Succ. 49ᵇ, v. יָרַע; a. fr.—Fem. יְרֵאָה, constr. יְרֵאַת.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 13</cite> (play on <he>י̇ר̇ושׁל̇ם̇</he>) <he>הבת שי̇ר̇אה ומשׁול̇מ̇ת לי</he> the daughter that fears (me) and is at peace with me.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:24">Ib.</cite> <he>כשאת יְרֵיאָה את מושלמת לי</he> Ar. (missing in ed.) when thou art God-fearing, thou art at peace with me.
<cite ref="Berakhot 33b">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 25a">Meg. 25ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

Koh. R. to IX, 7; Pesik. Ul’kaḥ., p. 183ᵇ, a. e. למען תִּוָּרֵא וכ׳ (Ps. CXXX, 4) ‘in order that thou mayest be feared’, that the fear of thee be put on mankind.—Part. נוֹרָא fearful, awe-inspiring. Ber. l. c.
Yoma 69ᵇ לא אמר נ׳ Jeremiah did not say nora (only gadol a. gibbor, Jer. XXXII, 18).—Fem. pl. ניֹרָאוֹת awe-inspiring deeds.
<cite ref="Jeremiah 32:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אתא … נכרים … איה נוֹרְאוֹתָיו</he> came Jeremiah and said, Strangers dance on His temple ruins, where are His awful deeds?; Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>לזה נאה לקרות נורא בנ׳ וכ׳</he> (Daniel said) Him it is becoming to call awe-inspiring for the awful deeds He performed for us &c.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 19:14">Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Zevachim 115b:15">Zeb. 115ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 68:36">Ps. LXVIII, 36</cite>) <he>בשעה … מִתְיָירֵא ומתעלה וכ׳</he> when the Lord executes judgment on His saints, He is feared and praised &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 525">Yalk. Lev. 525</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 61b:6">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>אי אתה מתי׳ מפני וכ׳</he> art thou not afraid of the (Roman) government?—Midr. Till. l. c. <he>שנכנסו … וכא נִתְיָירְאוּ</he> the enemy entered His house and were not afraid (of the Lord).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 29:9">Ex. R. s. 29</cite> <he>אם המטרונה מִתְיָירֵאת וכ׳</he> if the queen is afraid, what shall the servants … do?; a. fr.
